as_told.title: Buzz Aldrin's WWII sighting per his sister; James Fox pursuit

plain: Buzz Aldrin is the astronaut who was the second person to walk on the Moon in 1969. Podcast host Jesse Michels, passing on what a documentary filmmaker named James Fox told him, says Aldrin told his sister that he saw a foo fighter, a strange light reported by military pilots, while flying fighter jets in Japan, and that he also saw UFOs on the way to the Moon. In another episode Michels dates the early sighting to the Second World War and describes Fox trying to get an interview with Aldrin in Monte Carlo in the late 1990s, without mentioning the Moon trip.
